newsitem.title: USA: US W. Coast prods ease as NYMEX pressured by APIs.
newsitem.headline: US W. Coast prods ease as NYMEX pressured by APIs.

text.p: U.S. West Coast wholesale CARB gasoline drifted lower late Wednesday in line with steep declines in U.S. energy futures markets, traders said.
Most other products were flat, amid quiet trade.

May crude oil futures settled 48 cents a barrel lower Wednesday, weighed by new inventory data showing a hefty 2.9-million-barrel build in crude stocks last week, according to the American Petroleum Institute (API)
"The nervous L.A. traders were out there selling," one trader said.
"They were trying to get out of their positions."
May unleaded gasoline also slide under pressure from large stock builds, falling 1.52 cents as supplies swelled by 3.6 million barrels.
Traders dismissed API data from Tuesday that showed a large 596,000-barrel fall in West Coast (PADD V) gasoline supply. The build contrasted with a nationwide build of 3.6 million.
CARB gasoline in Los Angeles moved down one cent to 71/72 cents a gallon late Wednesday.
CARB diesel eased one cent as well, falling to 72/73 cents a gallon.
